author: Mateus Silva
name: .NET Clean Architecture Template
description: Production-ready Clean Architecture solution with Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and WebAPI layers. Includes CQRS/MediatR, EF Core, JWT auth, Outbox pattern, Soft Delete, Caching, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, and more.

Framework.description: The target framework for the projects.

UseDocker.description: Include Dockerfile, docker-compose (SQL Server, Redis, Jaeger, Prometheus, Grafana).

UseRedis.description: Configure distributed cache to use Redis instead of in-memory. Requires Redis connection string.

IncludeAIModule.description: Include the Modules.AI example project (Claude API integration).
